summary: iter313 frontend E2E for Universal Save-as-Draft across 5 wizards + Drafts dashboard sub-tab. Storage flow PASSES end-to-end (save→Drafts tab render→Resume hydrates URL→Delete→Empty state). Marketplace & Lots Save buttons render but the click produced NO /api/drafts/save network request (likely overlay/race or button onClick not firing). Vehicle and Multi-Lot Vehicle Save buttons are NOT RENDERED — pages return 403s for testseller (vehicle wizard is gated behind dealer verification, which testseller does not have). Drafts tab UI, expiry badges, Resume (hydration URL with draft_id), Delete confirm flow, and Empty state all verified.

ui_bugs.issue: Save as Draft button is present but clicking it does NOT trigger POST /api/drafts/save (no network request, no toast). Possible causes: cookie-consent overlay intercepting clicks on the wizard page (banner observed at bottom of viewport on /seller/dashboard for the same session), button onClick disabled state, or React not hydrated. Needs main-agent debug.
Save as Draft button present but click does NOT trigger POST /api/drafts/save. Same symptom as Marketplace.

save-as-draft-btn-vehicle is NOT rendered on the page for testseller@bidvex.com. Page navigated but no draft testids found at all and several 403/404 console errors. Vehicle wizard appears gated behind dealer verification — testseller is not a vehicle dealer. Either (a) move SaveAsDraftButton above the dealer-gate so partial drafts are still allowed, or (b) re-test with testdealer@bidvex.com.
save-as-draft-btn-multi_lot_vehicle is NOT rendered. Same dealer-gate likely applies.

integration_issues.issue: Click handler does not fire the axios POST. Storage wizard with identical SaveAsDraftButton works correctly (200 + draft_id + toast), so the universal button component itself is healthy — the difference is page-level (overlay / gate / hydration timing).

issues: Cookie Consent dialog appears anchored over the Drafts tab content even after localStorage consent is set (the banner re-appears on this preview URL). It does not block Drafts tab interactions but is visually distracting.

verified_passing: FEATURE 3 Storage Save-as-Draft: POST /api/drafts/save returned 200 with draft_id=24d4a911-… expires_in_days=30.

FEATURE 6 Unified Drafts sub-tab: data-testid='tab-drafts' visible in /seller/dashboard, click activates SellerDrafts which renders data-testid='seller-drafts-tab' with a Storage badge, title, expiry pill, Resume + Delete buttons.
FEATURE 7 Resume Draft: clicking data-testid='edit-draft-{id}' navigates to /storage-auctions/create?draft_id={id} (correct wizard + correct query param).
FEATURE 8 Delete Draft: window.confirm accepted → DELETE /api/drafts/{id} → draft removed from list → 'Draft deleted' toast shown.
FEATURE 9 Empty state: data-testid='seller-drafts-empty' renders 'No saved drafts yet.' after the last draft is deleted.
not_tested: FEATURE 10 Restore Expired Draft — P1 requires direct DB mutation; not executed in this run (requested as skip-able).
action_items: Debug why save-as-draft-btn-marketplace and save-as-draft-btn-lots click handlers do not fire POST /api/drafts/save. Check for cookie-consent or other overlay z-index intercepting pointer events on /create-listing and /create-multi-item-listing.

Confirm whether SaveAsDraftButton should render on /vehicle-auctions/create and /vehicle-auctions/multi-lot/create for non-dealer users. If yes, move the button above the dealer-verification gate. If no, re-test with testdealer@bidvex.com (TestDealer2026!) which has is_vehicle_dealer=True and vehicle_dealer_verified=True.
Investigate the 403/404 console errors on /vehicle-auctions/create — they confirm the page is partially blocked for the seller role.
critical_code_review_comments: SellerDrafts.jsx imports from '../../components/ui/{card,button,badge}' — confirmed correct path (file at src/pages/seller/SellerDrafts.jsx, ui at src/components/ui/). Earlier import-path bug fix is verified compiled cleanly.

SaveAsDraftButton uses JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(formData)) which silently drops File objects — acceptable for draft persistence but consider warning the user that uploaded images are not preserved in drafts.
SellerDashboard.js is 1100+ lines — should be split into smaller tab components for maintainability (Drafts is already extracted; Listings/Earnings/Analytics could follow).

success_rate.frontend: Storage wizard 100%, Drafts tab UI/Resume/Delete/Empty 100%, Marketplace/Lots save click 0%, Vehicle/Multi-Lot Vehicle button render 0%. Overall ~55% of the 9 in-scope features verified.

test_credentials: testseller@bidvex.com / TestSeller2026! — login verified working. For vehicle-wizard retesting use testdealer@bidvex.com / TestDealer2026!.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted 1 storage draft (id=24d4a911-e001-401a-bb3b-fb21aa9b569c) during the run; DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage Save-as-Draft is the reference implementation that works. When debugging Marketplace/Lots, focus on whether the button onClick fires at all (add a console.log) and whether any overlay is intercepting clicks. For Vehicle and Multi-Lot Vehicle, log in as testdealer@bidvex.com (TestDealer2026!) which has verified vehicle dealer status — the testseller account is non-dealer and the vehicle wizards likely gate render behind that.
rca of the issue: Storage path proves the universal SaveAsDraftButton component + backend POST /api/drafts/save + Drafts dashboard sub-tab + Resume URL hydration + Delete + Empty state all function correctly. Marketplace/Lots failures are page-level (click never reaches handler). Vehicle/Multi-Lot Vehicle failures are gate-level (button not in DOM because the wizard page is restricted for non-dealer testseller account).
